description.value:
Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Athena's Temper].

Every Libra weapon carries the property rune you chose this morning, until you choose again tomorrow.

Automation note: the rune is added as a strike adjustment rather than etched onto the twelve items. pf2e trims a weapon's property runes to the number of potency slots it has in its own source data, and the Arms Advance grants their potency as an alteration rather than an etched rune — so a rune written onto the item is trimmed straight back off before anyone sees it. A strike adjustment is applied where the Strike is built, after the Advance has been counted, and it reaches the Shields' generated weapon too.
